name: Being Ready
overview: Scripture emphasizes the necessity of being spiritually prepared for the unexpected return of Christ, urging believers to remain watchful and ready since the exact timing is unknown. The warnings in Matthew and Luke highlight that the Son of man will come at an hour when it is not anticipated, calling for constant vigilance. Proverbs illustrates the principle of diligence in preparation, contrasting the sluggard who neglects readiness and suffers loss, thereby reinforcing the wisdom of proactive readiness. Additionally, Luke encourages believers to anticipate redemption with hope as the signs of Christ’s coming begin to unfold.
